parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
At intersections, $2x+2=5x^{1/2}$, or $4x^2-17x+4=0$, or $2y^2-25y+50=0$; rearrange and validly solve — M1. Factors may be $(2x^{1/2}-1)(x^{1/2}-2)$, $(4x-1)(x-4)$ or $(2y-5)(y-10)$.
$x=\frac14,4$ — A1. If M1 not scored, SC B1 for correct answers, possibly seen as limits.
$\text{Area}=\int_{1/4}^{4}\{5x^{1/2}-(2x+2)\}\,dx$ — *M1. Intention to integrate and subtract areas; condone missing brackets or reversed subtraction.
$\left[\frac{10}{3}x^{3/2}-x^2-2x\right]_{1/4}^{4}$ — DM1. Integrate and substitute their found intersection points; limits must not merely be assumed.
$\frac{45}{16}=2\frac{13}{16}=2.8125$ — A1; OE exact. Condone $-\frac{45}{16}$ only if corrected; A0 for inclusion of $\pi$. SC: if *M1 DM0, SC B1 for correct answer.
Alternative: integrate curve and subtract line integral or trapezium, using the same intersection values and correct trapezium formula; same allocation and total. Total: 5.
